race.description: Ladbrokes Spring Racing Carnival C,G&E Mdn Plate
race.comment: BUDDA BAR (8) caught the eye on debut when closing off strongly behind Graffitude in what has proven a red-hot maiden. Loomed up to let down with a strong finish when well backed last time but was chopped out at a crucial stage. Peaking now and with even luck he'll get the job done. SPEEDY CROWN (4) has built nicely and looms as the main danger fourth-up on the back of some strong closing efforts. Gets the chance to settle closer from the inside pillar, and if the gap appears he can give this a shake. TRAMCA (13) has had genuine excuses at both runs this campaign, racing wide last start after working home into second two back, and only has to handle the 1200m more cleanly to be right in the winning mix. TIVACIOUS (6) is a Tivaci gelding on debut for the Healy camp. Has shown enough in his lead-up work to suggest he can make his presence felt.
